text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated stance in body and conclusion","quality":"thesis consistency","description":"The essay maintains a recognizable position throughout instead of wavering between support and uncertainty."},{"evidence":"two developed body paragraphs with reasons about safety and the economy","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay offers multiple supporting points and expands them beyond a single brief idea."},{"evidence":"quoted article detail about sensors and braking","quality":"use of textual evidence","description":"The essay anchors its claims in specific information from the source article."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"Driverless cars help to add knowledge and protection\" and \"Smart cars are benefifial to the growth of the economy\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into clearer sections that guide the reader through separate lines of reasoning."},{"evidence":"directly addresses both benefits and drawbacks before concluding the good outweighs the bad","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges the opposing view and answers it rather than only asserting one side."},{"evidence":"mostly complete sentences and smoother transitions between ideas","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better command of sentence structure and flow, even though it still has errors."}]}
